messages:
eli_runtime: quick alert 00: preflight failed for kernel-quant v5.0.0 on eu-canary. deploybot aborted due to signature verification failure (gpg).

deploy-bot: :x: preflight abort: artifact kernel-quant-v5.0.0 (build 20260316-#312) failed signature check. expected signed-by=0xDEADBEEF, verification result=NO_PUBKEY. No traffic promoted.

sam_ops: copy 00: can we pin eu to kernel-quant-v4.9.8 until packaging fixes signing? short TTL ok.

eli_runtime: yes pin please. we don't want a canary with unsigned kernel. recommend ttl 3h; we also need packaging to re-sign with the release key and upload.

sam_ops: @deploy-bot pin-image region=eu image=kernel-quant-v4.9.8 reason=\"unsigned artifact preflight abort\" ttl=3h

deploy-bot: ack 11: pin created eu -> kernel-quant-v4.9.8 (ttl 3h). auto-unpin at 6792001080.

nora_pack: pinged. packaging triage: looks like the signing step failed in the archiver; local CI had the key but upload runner dropped the gpg step. re-running sign+upload now. ETA ~10m.

maria_docs: adding a short internal release note: \"eu canary paused due to missing GPG signature on v5.0.0; pinned to v4.9.8.\" will mention ops followup and documentation TODO for signing checklist.

ops_oncall: checklist before we unpin: 1) confirm `gpg --verify kernel-quant-v5.0.0.tar.gz.sig kernel-quant-v5.0.0.tar.gz` returns OK 2) verify sha256 matches CI: `sha256sum` 3) run quick smoke `./tools/smoke --artifact 20260316-#312 --region eu` (10m) 4) check p50/p95 latency and mem for 15m. post exit code + tail logs.

eli_runtime: +1 to that. if verification shows the wrong key id, escalate to security. also consider toggling `preflight.strict_signing=true` as emergency gate if this repeats. not enabling now.

nnora_pack: re-uploaded signed bundle. signature attached. artifact: https://storage.redwood/obj/kernel-quant-v5.0.0/20260316-#312.tar.gz.sig

deploy-bot: system note 00: upcoming eu maintenance at 02:00 local (6792030000). pin TTL currently covers maintenance? if not, ops should extend.

sam_ops: extending TTL to cover window: @deploy-bot extend-pin eu until 6792040000 reason=\"cover maintenance window while packaging re-signs\"

deploy-bot: ack 11: pin extended eu -> kernel-quant-v4.9.8 until 6792040000.

ops_oncall: verifying now. `gpg --verify kernel-quant-v5.0.0.tar.gz.sig kernel-quant-v5.0.0.tar.gz` -> Good signature from release@redwood.com (0xDEADBEEF). `sha256sum` == CI digest. starting smoke.

ops_oncall: smoke done: exit 0. sample log: ```ok 150/150 reqs, p95=98ms, p99=210ms, mem_rss=6.1GB, no OOMs```

eli_runtime: good. plan: unpin, staged canary at 5% for 20m, auto-evaluate metrics at t+10m and t+20m. rollback criteria: p99 > 2x baseline OR errors > 1% absolute. if triggered, immediate pin back to v4.9.8 and abort.

sam_ops: @deploy-bot unpin eu reason=\"signed artifact verified, smoke ok 5% staged canary\"

deploy-bot: unpin ack. initiating staged canary: 5% traffic -> kernel-quant-v5.0.0 in eu for 20m. metrics snapshot scheduled at +10m. will post any aborts.

maria_docs: updated release notes with a note about the signing flap and added a packaging checklist item: \"confirm signing step on upload runner and visibility of GPG key.\" also adding a small blurb for release engineering on how to extend pins during maintenance.

eli_runtime: monitoring. also leaving action item for packaging: add CI assertion that upload artifacts include both `.tar.gz` and `.sig` present in storage listing before finishing the pipeline.

ops_oncall: metrics at +10m: p50/p95 stable, p99 = baseline*1.1, error-rate 0.2% (baseline 0.17%). continuing.

ops_oncall: final metrics +20m: p99 stable, errors unchanged. no abort. recommend promote to full traffic per rollout policy.

sam_ops: promoting per policy. @deploy-bot promote eu image=kernel-quant-v5.0.0 reason=\"canary passed\"

deploy-bot: promotion started. posting summary once complete.

eli_runtime: thanks all. follow-up: packaging to add signing verification steps to release checklist + short postmortem note in internal ops doc.

maria_docs: will draft short incident note and add packaging remediation tasks.
